news.headline: India's exports of software services up by 8.2% in FY26 to US$ 221.4 billion
news.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) released the data related to the 2025-26 round of its annual survey on computer software and information technology enabled services (ITES) exports. For 2025-26 round of the survey, 7,569 software export companies were contacted, of which 2,363 companies, including most of the large companies, responded. RBI stated that India's exports of software services (excluding their sales through overseas commercial presence) increased by 8.2 per cent (y-o-y) during 2025-26 to US$ 221.4 billion.
news.takeaway: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) released the data related to the 2025-26 round of its annual survey; trade-flow news separates exporters from import-cost sectors, so the index read needs sector confirmation.
news.whyItMatters: Financial cues matter because Bank Nifty often decides whether a Nifty move becomes a trend or just a gap reaction.
news.indiaImpact: Bank Nifty, private banks and NBFCs are the direct check; weak financial market participation can cap Nifty even if global cues are firm.
news.watchFor: Watch private-bank market participation through 9:45-10:00 AM IST; no long bias if financials lag Nifty.

news.headline: Bitcoin reclaims $80,000, Ethereum nears $2,620 despite hawkish Fed, CLARITY Act setback
news.summary: Bitcoin reclaimed $80,000 and Ethereum approached $2,620 as crypto markets recovered despite a hawkish Federal Reserve stance and uncertainty around the CLARITY Act. Improving risk sentiment, cooling oil prices and short liquidations supported the rebound, while ETF outflows, elevated rates and regulatory uncertainty remain key factors shaping the market outlook.
news.takeaway: Bitcoin reclaimed $80,000 and Ethereum approached $2,620 as crypto markets recovered despite a hawkish Federal Reserve stance; keep the oil story tied to Brent direction before turning it into an India equity signal.
news.whyItMatters: India imports most of its crude, so the same story can pressure inflation expectations while helping upstream energy.
news.indiaImpact: India read-through is conditional on Brent: firm prices pressure OMCs and aviation, softer prices support margin relief.
news.watchFor: Watch Brent at $80; direction after Asia opens decides whether the story matters for OMCs.
